Bitcoin, blockchain & how it works 0Likes1,293ViewsJan 162026 What exactly is cryptocurrency, and how is it different from the money we use every day? In this kid-friendly video, we explain what crypto is, how coins like Bitcoin and Ethereum work, and why cryptocurrency doesn’t rely on banks the way traditional money does. Kids learn about blockchain, digital payments, and why people are excited about crypto’s future—even though it isn’t widely used yet. Kids and teens will learn: • What cryptocurrency is and why it’s fully digital • How Bitcoin became the first cryptocurrency in 2009 • Why crypto doesn’t rely on banks or central systems • How millions of computers record transactions using blockchain • How crypto payments can be fast and low-cost • Why some people buy crypto as an investment • Why crypto isn’t widely accepted as payment (yet) • How crypto could shape the future of money This Money Mission helps kids and teens understand the basics of cryptocurrency and why it’s such a big part of conversations about the future of money.
